# ── Raw datasets ───────────────────────────────────────────
soil_points_nutrients <- read.csv(
  "../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/soil/perry_soil_points_surface_03_2026.csv"
) %>% clean_names()

ap_val <- read_csv(
  "../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/Ap_hz_data/hz_0_15_wide_03_30_2026.csv"
)

covariate_stack <- rast(
  "../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif"
)

# ── Agronomic soil variable subset ────────────────────────

soil_vars <- c("lbc_1", "lb_ceq", "p_h_2", "ca", "k", "mg", "mn", "p", "zn")
cov_names <- names(covariate_stack)

# ── Helper functions ───────────────────────────────────────
add_xy <- function(dat) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
  dat %>% mutate(X = coords[, 1], Y = coords[, 2])
}

extract_covariates <- function(dat_sf, stack) {
  vect_pts <- terra::vect(dat_sf)
  cov_vals <- terra::extract(stack, vect_pts)
  bind_cols(
    dat_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
    cov_vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(geometry = st_geometry(dat_sf)) %>%
    st_as_sf()
}

# ── SP and COMP modelling datasets ────────────────────────
soil_prop_SP <- soil_points_nutrients %>%
  filter(type == "SPID") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(26917) %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

soil_prop_COMP <- soil_points_nutrients %>%
  filter(type == "CID") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(26917) %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

    point_label = paste0("VAL_", Point),

# ── Spatial distribution check ────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = soil_prop_SP,   color = "steelblue",   size = 2) +

# ============================================================
# PHASE 2 — Spatial Cross-Validation Setup
# ============================================================

```{r spatial-cv-setup}
make_spatial_folds <- function(sf_data, k = 5, seed = 20260401) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(sf_data)
  set.seed(seed)
  km <- kmeans(coords, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  sf_data$spatial_block <- as.character(km$cluster)

  folds <- CAST::CreateSpacetimeFolds(
    x        = sf_data %>% st_drop_geometry(),
    spacevar = "spatial_block",
    k        = k,
    seed     = seed
  )

  purrr::map(seq_along(folds$index), function(i) {
    list(
      iteration = i,
      seed      = seed,
      train_ids = folds$index[[i]],
      test_ids  = folds$indexOut[[i]]
    )
  })
}

resamples_SP   <- make_spatial_folds(soil_prop_SP,   k = 5)
resamples_COMP <- make_spatial_folds(soil_prop_COMP, k = 5)

make_cutoff <- function(sf_data) max(dist(st_coordinates(sf_data))) / 2
width_lag   <- 75

cutoff_SP   <- make_cutoff(soil_prop_SP)
cutoff_COMP <- make_cutoff(soil_prop_COMP)

# Visualise spatial blocks
soil_prop_SP$spatial_block <- as.character(
  kmeans(st_coordinates(soil_prop_SP), centers = 5, nstart = 25)$cluster
)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = soil_prop_SP, aes(color = spatial_block), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Spatial CV blocks — SP dataset", color = "Block")
```

# ============================================================
# PHASE 3 — Model Fitting Helpers (RF, OK, RK)
# ============================================================

```{r model-helpers}
calc_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  tibble(
    n          = length(obs),
    RMSE       = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE        = mean(abs(obs - pred),      na.rm = TRUE),
    R2         = cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2,
    mean_error = mean(obs - pred,           na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

tune_rf_oob <- function(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  x_train   <- train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors))
  y_train   <- train_df[[response]]
  p         <- length(predictors)
  mtry_grid <- unique(pmax(1, c(
    floor(sqrt(p)), floor(p / 4), floor(p / 3), floor(p / 2)
  )))

  fits <- purrr::map(mtry_grid, function(m) {
    set.seed(sample.int(1e6, 1))
    rf <- randomForest(x = x_train, y = y_train,
                       ntree = ntree, mtry = m, importance = TRUE)
    tibble(mtry = m, oob_mse = tail(rf$mse, 1))
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  list(
    best_mtry    = fits %>% slice_min(oob_mse, n = 1) %>% pull(mtry),
    tuning_table = fits
  )
}

fit_variogram_models <- function(vg) {
  vg_df       <- as.data.frame(vg)
  init_nugget <- max(0, min(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  init_sill   <- max(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  init_psill  <- max(init_sill - init_nugget, 1e-6)
  init_range  <- max(vg_df$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3

  fits <- purrr::map(c("Sph", "Exp"), function(m) {
    tryCatch({
      fit <- fit.variogram(
        vg,
        model = vgm(psill = init_psill, model = m,
                    range = init_range,  nugget = init_nugget)
      )
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill)))               return(NULL)
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$range)))               return(NULL)
      if (any(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] <= 0))  return(NULL)
      fit
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })

  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  if (length(fits) == 0) return(NULL)

  sse      <- sapply(fits, function(f) attr(f, "SSErr"))
  best_fit <- fits[[which.min(sse)]]

  # Degeneracy guard — pure nugget = constant surface
  str_row <- best_fit %>% filter(model != "Nug")
  if (nrow(str_row) > 0 && str_row$psill < 1e-6) {
    warning("Degenerate variogram fit: psill ≈ 0. Returning NULL.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  best_fit
}

# ── RF ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_rf_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response,
                          predictors, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf  %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  tuning  <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree)
  rf_fit  <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree, mtry = tuning$best_mtry, importance = TRUE
  )
  preds <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  list(
    model       = rf_fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = test_df[[response]], pred = preds),
    metrics     = calc_metrics(test_df[[response]], preds),
    best_mtry   = tuning$best_mtry
  )
}

# ── OK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_ok_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff, width) {
  train_sp <- as(train_sf, "Spatial")
  test_sp  <- as(test_sf,  "Spatial")
  f        <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
  vg       <- variogram(f, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit      <- fit_variogram_models(vg)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  kr   <- krige(f, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit)
  pred <- kr$var1.pred
  obs  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% pull(.data[[response]])
  list(
    variogram   = vg,
    fit         = fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
    metrics     = calc_metrics(obs, pred)
  )
}

# ── RK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_rk_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors,
                          cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf  %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  train_sf2 <- train_sf %>%
    filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(
      select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))
  test_sf2  <- test_sf  %>%
    filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(
      select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))

  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree)
  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree, mtry = tuning$best_mtry, importance = TRUE
  )

  trend_train        <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_df %>%
                                  select(all_of(predictors)))
  trend_test         <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df  %>%
                                  select(all_of(predictors)))
  train_sf2$residual <- train_df[[response]] - trend_train

  train_sp  <- as(train_sf2, "Spatial")
  test_sp   <- as(test_sf2,  "Spatial")
  vg_resid  <- variogram(residual ~ 1, data = train_sp,
                          cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)

  if (is.null(fit_resid)) {
    return(list(
      metrics               = calc_metrics(test_df[[response]], trend_test),
      best_mtry             = tuning$best_mtry,
      used_residual_kriging = FALSE
    ))
  }

  kr_resid <- krige(residual ~ 1, locations = train_sp,
                    newdata = test_sp, model = fit_resid)
  pred     <- trend_test + kr_resid$var1.pred
  obs      <- test_df[[response]]

  list(
    metrics               = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
    best_mtry             = tuning$best_mtry,
    used_residual_kriging = TRUE
  )
}

# ── Combined iteration runner ──────────────────────────────
run_one_iteration <- function(sf_data, split, response, predictors,
                               dataset_name, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  test_sf  <- sf_data[split$test_ids,  ]

  rf_res <- run_rf_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree)
  ok_res <- run_ok_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff, width)
  rk_res <- run_rk_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors,
                          cutoff, width, ntree)

  bind_rows(
    rf_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(dataset = dataset_name, variable = response, method = "RF",
             iteration = split$iteration, seed = split$seed,
             best_mtry = rf_res$best_mtry),
    if (!is.null(ok_res))
      ok_res$metrics %>%
        mutate(dataset = dataset_name, variable = response, method = "OK",
               iteration = split$iteration, seed = split$seed,
               best_mtry = NA_real_),
    rk_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(dataset = dataset_name, variable = response, method = "RK",
             iteration = split$iteration, seed = split$seed,
             best_mtry = rk_res$best_mtry,
             used_residual_kriging = rk_res$used_residual_kriging)
  )
}
```

         method  = factor(method,  c("OK", "RF", "RK"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = method, y = R2, fill = method)) +

# Reshape CV results for statistical comparison
cv_long <- cv_summary %>%
  mutate(method_design = paste(method, dataset, sep = "_"))

# Friedman test — does method × sampling design affect R²?
friedman_result <- cv_long %>%
  friedman_test(median_R2 ~ method_design | variable)

print(friedman_result)

# Post-hoc pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank tests
posthoc_result <- cv_long %>%
  wilcox_test(median_R2 ~ method_design,
              paired = TRUE,
              p.adjust.method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance()

print(posthoc_result, n = 30)
# SP vs COMP comparison within each method
sp_comp_comparison <- cv_summary %>%
  select(variable, method, dataset, median_R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset,
              values_from = median_R2) %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    wilcox_p = wilcox.test(SP, COMP,
                            paired = TRUE,
                            exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    median_diff = median(SP - COMP, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(significant = wilcox_p < 0.05)

print(sp_comp_comparison)
# Method comparison within SP and COMP
method_comparison <- cv_summary %>%
  select(variable, method, dataset, median_R2) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    # RF vs OK
    rf_ok_p = wilcox.test(
      median_R2[method == "RF"],
      median_R2[method == "OK"],
      paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    # RF vs RK
    rf_rk_p = wilcox.test(
      median_R2[method == "RF"],
      median_R2[method == "RK"],
      paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    # RK vs OK
    rk_ok_p = wilcox.test(
      median_R2[method == "RK"],
      median_R2[method == "OK"],
      paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(method_comparison)

# PHASE 4 — Final Full-Dataset Models + Held-Out Validation

```{r final-models}
fit_final_rf <- function(sf_data, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  df     <- sf_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(df, response, predictors, ntree)
  randomForest(
    x          = df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y          = df[[response]],
    ntree      = ntree,
    mtry       = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )
}

fit_final_ok <- function(sf_data, response, cutoff, width) {
  sp_data <- as(sf_data, "Spatial")
  f       <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
  vg      <- variogram(f, data = sp_data, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit     <- fit_variogram_models(vg)
  list(variogram = vg, fit = fit, formula = f, sp_data = sp_data)
}

fit_final_rk <- function(sf_data, response, predictors,
                          cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  df      <- sf_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  sf_data2 <- sf_data %>%
    filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(
      select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))

  tuning  <- tune_rf_oob(df, response, predictors, ntree)
  rf_fit  <- randomForest(
    x = df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree, mtry = tuning$best_mtry, importance = TRUE
  )
  trend             <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = df %>%
                                 select(all_of(predictors)))
  sf_data2$residual <- df[[response]] - trend

  sp_data  <- as(sf_data2, "Spatial")
  vg_resid <- variogram(residual ~ 1, data = sp_data,
                         cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)

  list(rf_fit = rf_fit, fit_resid = fit_resid, sp_data = sp_data)
}

final_models_SP <- purrr::map(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars),
  function(v) list(
    rf = fit_final_rf(soil_prop_SP, v, cov_names),
    ok = fit_final_ok(soil_prop_SP, v, cutoff_SP, width_lag),
    rk = fit_final_rk(soil_prop_SP, v, cov_names, cutoff_SP, width_lag)
  )
)

final_models_COMP <- purrr::map(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars),
  function(v) list(
    rf = fit_final_rf(soil_prop_COMP, v, cov_names),
    ok = fit_final_ok(soil_prop_COMP, v, cutoff_COMP, width_lag),
    rk = fit_final_rk(soil_prop_COMP, v, cov_names, cutoff_COMP, width_lag)
  )
)

beep("fanfare")

```{r variogram-summary}
# ── Phase 4b: Variogram model summary ─────────────────────
extract_variogram_summary <- function(final_models, soil_vars, label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
    fit <- final_models[[v]]$ok$fit
    if (is.null(fit)) {
      return(tibble(variable = v, dataset = label,
                    model = NA, nugget = NA, psill = NA,
                    total_sill = NA, range_m = NA,
                    nugget_sill_ratio = NA))
    }
    nug_row  <- fit %>% filter(model == "Nug")
    str_row  <- fit %>% filter(model != "Nug")
    nugget   <- if (nrow(nug_row) > 0) nug_row$psill else 0
    psill    <- if (nrow(str_row) > 0) str_row$psill else NA
    rng      <- if (nrow(str_row) > 0) str_row$range else NA
    mod_type <- if (nrow(str_row) > 0) as.character(str_row$model) else NA
    tibble(variable = v, dataset = label, model = mod_type,
           nugget   = round(nugget, 4), psill = round(psill, 4),
           total_sill = round(nugget + psill, 4),
           range_m    = round(rng, 1),
           nugget_sill_ratio = round(nugget / (nugget + psill), 3))
  })
}

vg_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  extract_variogram_summary(final_models_SP,   soil_vars, "SP"),
  extract_variogram_summary(final_models_COMP, soil_vars, "COMP")
)

vg_summary_all %>%
  mutate(spatial_dependence = case_when(
    nugget_sill_ratio < 0.25 ~ "Strong",
    nugget_sill_ratio < 0.75 ~ "Moderate",
    TRUE                     ~ "Weak — kriging limited"
  )) %>%
  arrange(dataset, variable) %>%
  print(n = 20)

write_csv(vg_summary_all, "../outputs/variogram_summary_table.csv")

```{r held-out-validation}
# ── Predict to held-out validation set ────────────────────
predict_to_points <- function(models_list, response, new_sf,
                               predictors, cutoff, width) {
  new_df <- new_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(any_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  obs    <- new_df[[response]]

  rf_pred <- predict(models_list$rf,
                     newdata = new_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))

  ok_pred <- tryCatch({
    kr <- krige(models_list$ok$formula,
                locations = models_list$ok$sp_data,
                newdata   = as(new_sf, "Spatial"),
                model     = models_list$ok$fit)
    kr$var1.pred
  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(new_df)))

  rk_trend <- predict(models_list$rk$rf_fit,
                      newdata = new_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  rk_resid <- tryCatch({
    new_sf2 <- new_sf %>%
      filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(
        select(., any_of(predictors)))))
    kr2 <- krige(residual ~ 1,
                 locations = models_list$rk$sp_data,
                 newdata   = as(new_sf2, "Spatial"),
                 model     = models_list$rk$fit_resid)
    kr2$var1.pred
  }, error = function(e) rep(0, length(rk_trend)))
  rk_pred <- rk_trend + rk_resid

  bind_rows(
    calc_metrics(obs, rf_pred) %>%
      mutate(variable = response, method = "RF"),
    calc_metrics(obs, ok_pred) %>%
      mutate(variable = response, method = "OK"),
    calc_metrics(obs, rk_pred) %>%
      mutate(variable = response, method = "RK")
  )
}

val_results_all <- bind_rows(
  purrr::map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
    predict_to_points(final_models_SP[[v]], v, ap_val_sf,
                      cov_names, cutoff_SP, width_lag) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "SP")
  }),
  purrr::map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
    predict_to_points(final_models_COMP[[v]], v, ap_val_sf,
                      cov_names, cutoff_COMP, width_lag) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "COMP")
  })
)

write_csv(val_results_all, "../outputs/validation_results_held_out.csv")
val_results_all %>% arrange(variable, dataset, desc(R2))

This is the more reliable finding since it comes from truly independent data.

# ── Extract importance from final RF models ────────────────
# Uses %IncMSE (permutation importance) — more reliable
# than node impurity (%IncNodePurity) for correlated predictors.
# Top-20 covariates shown per variable × dataset.

extract_importance <- function(rf_model, variable, dataset) {
  imp <- importance(rf_model, type = 1) # type=1 = %IncMSE
  tibble(
    covariate = rownames(imp),
    pct_inc_mse = imp[, 1],
    variable  = variable,
    dataset   = dataset
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(pct_inc_mse))
}

  extract_importance(final_models_SP[[v]]$rf, v, "SP")
})

  extract_importance(final_models_COMP[[v]]$rf, v, "COMP")
})

plot_importance_per_var <- function(imp_df, dataset_label) {
  imp_df %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_label) %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = pct_inc_mse, n = 20) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(covariate = tidytext::reorder_within(
      covariate, pct_inc_mse, variable)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = covariate, y = pct_inc_mse,
               fill = pct_inc_mse)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("RF Variable Importance — ",
                        dataset_label, " dataset"),
      subtitle = "Top 20 covariates by %IncMSE (permutation importance)",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "% Increase in MSE"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# PHASE 5 — Full-Grid Spatial Prediction
# ============================================================

```{r grid-prediction}
grid_df <- as.data.frame(covariate_stack, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
grid_sf <- st_as_sf(grid_df, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 26917)
grid_sp <- as(grid_sf, "Spatial")

predict_grid_rf <- function(rf_model, grid_df, predictors) {
  predict(rf_model, newdata = grid_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
}

predict_grid_ok <- function(ok_obj, grid_sp) {
  tryCatch({
    kr <- krige(ok_obj$formula,
                locations = ok_obj$sp_data,
                newdata   = grid_sp,
                model     = ok_obj$fit)
    kr$var1.pred
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("OK prediction failed; returning NA")
    rep(NA_real_, nrow(grid_sp@data))
  })
}

predict_grid_rk <- function(rk_obj, grid_df, grid_sp, predictors) {
  trend <- predict(rk_obj$rf_fit,
                   newdata = grid_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  resid <- tryCatch({
    kr2 <- krige(residual ~ 1,
                 locations = rk_obj$sp_data,
                 newdata   = grid_sp,
                 model     = rk_obj$fit_resid)
    kr2$var1.pred
  }, error = function(e) rep(0, length(trend)))
  trend + resid
}

build_prediction_stack <- function(final_models, grid_df, grid_sf,
                                    grid_sp, soil_vars, predictors,
                                    label) {
  preds <- purrr::map(setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars), function(v) {
    m <- final_models[[v]]
    tibble(
      !!paste0(v, "_RF") := predict_grid_rf(m$rf, grid_df, predictors),
      !!paste0(v, "_RK") := predict_grid_rk(m$rk, grid_df, grid_sp, predictors),
      !!paste0(v, "_OK") := predict_grid_ok(m$ok, grid_sp)
    )
  }) %>% bind_cols()

  bind_cols(grid_df %>% select(x, y), preds, dataset = label)
}

pred_stack_SP   <- build_prediction_stack(
  final_models_SP,   grid_df, grid_sf, grid_sp,
  soil_vars, cov_names, "SP")
pred_stack_COMP <- build_prediction_stack(
  final_models_COMP, grid_df, grid_sf, grid_sp,
  soil_vars, cov_names, "COMP")

beep("mario")
save.image("../outputs/workspace_phase4b.RData")
beep("coin")

# ============================================================
# PHASE 5b — Spatial Lag Features
# ============================================================

```{r spatial-lags}
add_spatial_lags_focal <- function(pred_df, soil_vars, methods,
                                    crs = "EPSG:26917") {
  col_names <- as.vector(outer(soil_vars, methods, paste, sep = "_"))
  col_names <- col_names[col_names %in% names(pred_df)]

  cat("Computing spatial lags via terra::focal for",
      length(col_names), "layers...\n")

  pred_rast <- pred_df %>%
    select(x, y, all_of(col_names)) %>%
    rast(type = "xyz", crs = crs)

  w       <- matrix(1, 3, 3)
  w[2, 2] <- 0
  lag_rast <- terra::focal(pred_rast, w = w,
                            fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
  names(lag_rast) <- paste0(col_names, "_lag")

  pts    <- terra::vect(pred_df %>% select(x, y),
                        geom = c("x", "y"), crs = crs)
  lag_df <- terra::extract(lag_rast, pts, ID = FALSE)

  cat("pred_df rows:", nrow(pred_df),
      "| lag rows:", nrow(lag_df), "\n")
  bind_cols(pred_df, lag_df)
}

pred_stack_SP_lag   <- add_spatial_lags_focal(
  pred_stack_SP,   soil_vars, c("RF", "RK"))
pred_stack_COMP_lag <- add_spatial_lags_focal(
  pred_stack_COMP, soil_vars, c("RF", "RK"))

cat("SP lag stack columns:",   ncol(pred_stack_SP_lag),   "\n")
cat("COMP lag stack columns:", ncol(pred_stack_COMP_lag), "\n")

# ============================================================
# PHASE 5c — Uncertainty Analysis

```{r uncertainty-analysis}
# ── 1. Quantile Regression Forest (RF Prediction Intervals) ─
# QRF extends RF to estimate conditional quantiles.
# We compute the 10th and 90th percentiles to produce
# an 80% prediction interval for each grid pixel.
# Interval width = spatial map of RF prediction uncertainty.

fit_qrf <- function(sf_data, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  df     <- sf_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(df, response, predictors, ntree)

  set.seed(20260401)
  quantregForest(
    x    = as.matrix(df %>% select(all_of(predictors))),
    y    = df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry  = tuning$best_mtry
  )
}

cat("Fitting QRF models for SP dataset...\n")
qrf_models_SP <- purrr::map(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars),
  ~ fit_qrf(soil_prop_SP, .x, cov_names)
)

cat("Fitting QRF models for COMP dataset...\n")
qrf_models_COMP <- purrr::map(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars),
  ~ fit_qrf(soil_prop_COMP, .x, cov_names)
)

# Predict 80% PI to grid
grid_mat <- as.matrix(grid_df %>% select(all_of(cov_names)))

predict_qrf_grid <- function(qrf_model, grid_mat,
                              quantiles = c(0.10, 0.90)) {
  preds <- predict(qrf_model, newdata = grid_mat,
                   what = quantiles)
  tibble(
    pi_lower = preds[, 1],
    pi_upper = preds[, 2],
    pi_width = preds[, 2] - preds[, 1]
  )
}

qrf_uncertainty_SP <- purrr::map_dfc(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars), function(v) {
    p <- predict_qrf_grid(qrf_models_SP[[v]], grid_mat)
    setNames(p, paste0(v, "_", names(p)))
  }
) %>% bind_cols(grid_df %>% select(x, y), .)

qrf_uncertainty_COMP <- purrr::map_dfc(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars), function(v) {
    p <- predict_qrf_grid(qrf_models_COMP[[v]], grid_mat)
    setNames(p, paste0(v, "_", names(p)))
  }
) %>% bind_cols(grid_df %>% select(x, y), .)

# ── QRF uncertainty maps — one panel per variable ─────────
plot_qrf_width <- function(qrf_df, dataset_label) {
  width_cols <- paste0(soil_vars, "_pi_width")
  width_cols <- width_cols[width_cols %in% names(qrf_df)]

  qrf_df %>%
    select(x, y, all_of(width_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "pi_width") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_pi_width")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = pi_width)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", direction = -1,
                          name = "PI width\n(80%)") +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("QRF 80% Prediction Interval Width — ",
                        dataset_label),
      subtitle = "Wider = higher RF prediction uncertainty",
      x = "Easting", y = "Northing"
    )
}

print(plot_qrf_width(qrf_uncertainty_SP,   "SP"))
print(plot_qrf_width(qrf_uncertainty_COMP, "COMP"))

write_csv(qrf_uncertainty_SP,
          "../outputs/qrf_uncertainty_SP.csv")
write_csv(qrf_uncertainty_COMP,
          "../outputs/qrf_uncertainty_COMP.csv")

# ── 2. Kriging Variance Surfaces (OK and RK) ──────────────
# krige() returns var1.var — the kriging variance at each
# prediction location. This is the geostatistical uncertainty
# estimate; sqrt(var1.var) = standard error of the kriging
# prediction. For RK, this is the residual kriging variance.

predict_grid_ok_with_var <- function(ok_obj, grid_sp) {
  tryCatch({
    kr <- krige(ok_obj$formula,
                locations = ok_obj$sp_data,
                newdata   = grid_sp,
                model     = ok_obj$fit)
    tibble(
      pred = kr$var1.pred,
      krig_var = kr$var1.var
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(pred    = rep(NA_real_, nrow(grid_sp@data)),
           krig_var = rep(NA_real_, nrow(grid_sp@data)))
  })
}

predict_grid_rk_with_var <- function(rk_obj, grid_df,
                                      grid_sp, predictors) {
  trend <- predict(rk_obj$rf_fit,
                   newdata = grid_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  resid_pred <- tryCatch({
    kr2 <- krige(residual ~ 1,
                 locations = rk_obj$sp_data,
                 newdata   = grid_sp,
                 model     = rk_obj$fit_resid)
    tibble(resid = kr2$var1.pred,
           krig_var = kr2$var1.var)
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(resid    = rep(0, length(trend)),
           krig_var = rep(NA_real_, length(trend)))
  })
  tibble(
    pred     = trend + resid_pred$resid,
    krig_var = resid_pred$krig_var
  )
}

krig_var_SP <- purrr::map_dfc(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars), function(v) {
    m <- final_models_SP[[v]]
    ok <- predict_grid_ok_with_var(m$ok, grid_sp)
    rk <- predict_grid_rk_with_var(m$rk, grid_df, grid_sp, cov_names)
    tibble(
      !!paste0(v, "_ok_krig_var") := ok$krig_var,
      !!paste0(v, "_rk_krig_var") := rk$krig_var
    )
  }
) %>% bind_cols(grid_df %>% select(x, y), .)

krig_var_COMP <- purrr::map_dfc(
  setNames(soil_vars, soil_vars), function(v) {
    m <- final_models_COMP[[v]]
    ok <- predict_grid_ok_with_var(m$ok, grid_sp)
    rk <- predict_grid_rk_with_var(m$rk, grid_df, grid_sp, cov_names)
    tibble(
      !!paste0(v, "_ok_krig_var") := ok$krig_var,
      !!paste0(v, "_rk_krig_var") := rk$krig_var
    )
  }
) %>% bind_cols(grid_df %>% select(x, y), .)

# ── Kriging SE maps ───────────────────────────────────────
plot_krig_se <- function(kv_df, dataset_label, method_suffix) {
  se_cols <- paste0(soil_vars, method_suffix)
  se_cols <- se_cols[se_cols %in% names(kv_df)]

  kv_df %>%
    select(x, y, all_of(se_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(se_cols), sqrt)) %>%  # var → SE
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "krig_se") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(
      variable, str_escape(method_suffix))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = krig_se)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1,
                          name = "Kriging SE",
                          na.value = "grey80") +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Kriging Standard Error — ",
                        dataset_label, " (",
                        str_remove(method_suffix,
                                   "_krig_var"), ")"),
      subtitle = "sqrt(kriging variance) at each grid pixel",
      x = "Easting", y = "Northing"
    )
}

print(plot_krig_se(krig_var_SP,   "SP",   "_ok_krig_var"))
print(plot_krig_se(krig_var_SP,   "SP",   "_rk_krig_var"))
print(plot_krig_se(krig_var_COMP, "COMP", "_ok_krig_var"))
print(plot_krig_se(krig_var_COMP, "COMP", "_rk_krig_var"))

# ── 3. Bootstrap Uncertainty for RF Predictions ───────────
# Bootstrap resampling of training data (B=100 replicates)
# to estimate prediction SD at each grid pixel.
# SD captures the sensitivity of RF predictions to the
# specific set of training observations used.

bootstrap_rf_uncertainty <- function(sf_data, soil_vars,
                                      predictors, grid_df,
                                      B = 100, ntree = 500,
                                      seed = 20260401) {
  cat("Bootstrap RF uncertainty (B =", B, "replicates)...\n")

  df_full <- sf_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(soil_vars, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  set.seed(seed)
  boot_preds <- purrr::map(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    if (b %% 10 == 0) cat(" Bootstrap rep:", b, "/", B, "\n")
    boot_idx <- sample(nrow(df_full), replace = TRUE)
    boot_df  <- df_full[boot_idx, ]

    purrr::map_dfc(soil_vars, function(v) {
      rf_b <- tryCatch({
        randomForest(
          x = boot_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
          y = boot_df[[v]],
          ntree = ntree, mtry = floor(sqrt(length(predictors)))
        )
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (is.null(rf_b)) {
        return(tibble(!!v := rep(NA_real_, nrow(grid_df))))
      }

      tibble(
        !!v := predict(rf_b,
                       newdata = grid_df %>%
                         select(all_of(predictors)))
      )
    })
  })

  # Compute SD across bootstrap replicates per pixel
  purrr::map_dfc(soil_vars, function(v) {
    boot_mat <- do.call(cbind, purrr::map(boot_preds, ~ .x[[v]]))
    tibble(
      !!paste0(v, "_boot_sd")   := apply(boot_mat, 1,
                                          sd, na.rm = TRUE),
      !!paste0(v, "_boot_mean") := apply(boot_mat, 1,
                                          mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_cols(grid_df %>% select(x, y), .)
}

# B=100 replicates — increase to 500 for publication
cat("Running bootstrap for SP dataset...\n")
boot_uncertainty_SP   <- bootstrap_rf_uncertainty(
  soil_prop_SP,   soil_vars, cov_names, grid_df, B = 100)

cat("Running bootstrap for COMP dataset...\n")
boot_uncertainty_COMP <- bootstrap_rf_uncertainty(
  soil_prop_COMP, soil_vars, cov_names, grid_df, B = 100)

# ── Bootstrap SD maps ─────────────────────────────────────
plot_boot_sd <- function(boot_df, dataset_label) {
  sd_cols <- paste0(soil_vars, "_boot_sd")
  sd_cols <- sd_cols[sd_cols %in% names(boot_df)]

  boot_df %>%
    select(x, y, all_of(sd_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "boot_sd") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_boot_sd")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = boot_sd)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "rocket", direction = -1,
                          name = "Bootstrap SD") +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("RF Bootstrap Uncertainty (B=100) — ",
                        dataset_label),
      subtitle = "SD of predictions across 100 bootstrap replicates",
      x = "Easting", y = "Northing"
    )
}

print(plot_boot_sd(boot_uncertainty_SP,   "SP"))
print(plot_boot_sd(boot_uncertainty_COMP, "COMP"))

write_csv(boot_uncertainty_SP,
          "../outputs/bootstrap_uncertainty_SP.csv")
write_csv(boot_uncertainty_COMP,
          "../outputs/bootstrap_uncertainty_COMP.csv")

#ERROR:
#Per-variable interpretation:

  # pH — bootstrap SD ~0.07–0.10, PI width ~0.9–1.1. Very tight, makes sense — pH varies narrowly at field scale and RF predicts it well
  # P — bootstrap SD ~2–3, PI width ~20–23. Low uncertainty relative to the other nutrients, consistent with P often being spatially structured by management history
  # K — moderate uncertainty, COMP tighter than SP which is expected given composite sampling smooths local variability
  # Ca and lb_ceq — largest absolute uncertainty, which makes sense as these are highly variable and correlated with soil texture and organic matter gradients
#The SP > COMP pattern for most variables is also exactly what I expect w/ composite samples average over a larger area so the RF trained on them sees less local noise, producing tighter predictions.

#P flips the pattern (COMP SD slightly higher than SP). That's worth a sentence in my methods ...it may reflect that composite sampling obscures real P spatial structure that single-point sampling captures, since P is often highly localized around application history.
# Kriging SE summary — OK
bind_rows(
  krig_var_SP %>%
    select(ends_with("_ok_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      mean   = ~ mean(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE),
      median = ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "SP", method = "OK kriging SE"),

  krig_var_COMP %>%
    select(ends_with("_ok_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      mean   = ~ mean(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE),
      median = ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "COMP", method = "OK kriging SE"),

  krig_var_SP %>%
    select(ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      mean   = ~ mean(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE),
      median = ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "SP", method = "RK kriging SE"),

  krig_var_COMP %>%
    select(ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      mean   = ~ mean(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE),
      median = ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "COMP", method = "RK kriging SE")
) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = str_extract(name, paste(soil_vars, collapse = "|")),
    stat     = if_else(str_detect(name, "_mean"), "mean", "median")
  ) %>%
  select(variable, stat, dataset, method, value) %>%
  arrange(variable, method, dataset, stat) 

# FINAL UNCERTAINTY SUMMARY:
# SP > COMP for most variables (SP higher uncertainty), except P (COMP slightly higher)
# OK > RK > RF in uncertainty magnitude
# HOWEVER — these are not apples-to-apples comparisons:
#   - OK SE is purely geometry-driven (data configuration)
#   - RK SE is residual kriging component only (incomplete — missing RF trend uncertainty)
#   - RF bootstrap SD captures training data sensitivity only
# RK total uncertainty = RF trend uncertainty + residual kriging variance (neither alone is complete)
# All three are complementary, not directly comparable on the same scale

```
```{r}
#uncertainty figure for raw maps:
# ── Unified uncertainty figure ─────────────────────────────
# Combines RF bootstrap SD, QRF PI width, and kriging SE
# for OK and RK into one comparable figure

soil_var_labels <- c(
  "lbc_1"  = "LBC-1",
  "lb_ceq" = "LBC Eq.",
  "p_h_2"  = "pH",
  "ca"     = "Calcium",
  "k"      = "Potassium",
  "mg"     = "Magnesium",
  "mn"     = "Manganese",

)

    pred_method = "RF",
    metric_type = method
  ) %>%
  select(variable, dataset, pred_method,
         metric_type, median_unc)

# ── 2. Kriging SE — OK and RK ─────────────────────────────
krig_se_long <- bind_rows(
  krig_var_SP %>%
    select(ends_with("_ok_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(),
                     ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = "name",
                 values_to = "median_unc") %>%
    mutate(dataset = "SP", pred_method = "OK"),

  krig_var_COMP %>%
    select(ends_with("_ok_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(),
                     ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = "name",
                 values_to = "median_unc") %>%
    mutate(dataset = "COMP", pred_method = "OK"),

  krig_var_SP %>%
    select(ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(),
                     ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = "name",
                 values_to = "median_unc") %>%
    mutate(dataset = "SP", pred_method = "RK"),

  krig_var_COMP %>%
    select(ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(),
                     ~ median(sqrt(.), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = "name",
                 values_to = "median_unc") %>%
    mutate(dataset = "COMP", pred_method = "RK")
) %>%
  mutate(
    variable    = str_extract(name,
                               paste(soil_vars, collapse = "|")),
    metric_type = "Kriging SE"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(variable), is.finite(median_unc)) %>%
  select(variable, dataset, pred_method,
         metric_type, median_unc)

# ── 3. Combine all uncertainty metrics ────────────────────
uncertainty_all <- bind_rows(
  rf_uncertainty %>%

) %>%

#RK uncertainty:
# ── RK total uncertainty = RF trend SD + RK kriging SE ────
# Assumes independence between trend and residual uncertainty
# Total SE = sqrt(boot_SD² + krig_SE²)

rk_total_uncertainty <- bind_rows(
  # SP
  boot_uncertainty_SP %>%
    select(x, y, ends_with("_boot_sd")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to = "variable",
                 values_to = "boot_sd") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_boot_sd"),
           dataset  = "SP") %>%
    left_join(
      krig_var_SP %>%
        select(x, y, ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
        pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                     names_to = "variable",
                     values_to = "krig_var") %>%
        mutate(variable = str_remove(variable,
                                      "_rk_krig_var"),
               dataset  = "SP"),
      by = c("x", "y", "variable", "dataset")
    ),

  # COMP
  boot_uncertainty_COMP %>%
    select(x, y, ends_with("_boot_sd")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to = "variable",
                 values_to = "boot_sd") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_boot_sd"),
           dataset  = "COMP") %>%
    left_join(
      krig_var_COMP %>%
        select(x, y, ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
        pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                     names_to = "variable",
                     values_to = "krig_var") %>%
        mutate(variable = str_remove(variable,
                                      "_rk_krig_var"),
               dataset  = "COMP"),
      by = c("x", "y", "variable", "dataset")
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Total RK uncertainty via quadrature
    # krig_var is variance so sqrt = SE
    rk_total_se = sqrt(boot_sd^2 + 
                       coalesce(krig_var, 0))
  )

# ── Summarise per variable and dataset ────────────────────
rk_uncertainty_summary <- rk_total_uncertainty %>%
  group_by(variable, dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rk_se   = round(mean(rk_total_se,
                               na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median_rk_se = round(median(rk_total_se,
                                 na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_method = "RK",
    metric_type = "Total SE (boot + krig)"
  )

print(rk_uncertainty_summary, n = 20)
write_csv(rk_uncertainty_summary,
          "../outputs/rk_total_uncertainty.csv")

               "COMP" = "Composite"),
        levels = c("Single-Point", "Composite")
      )
    ),

  # RK kriging SE — residual only
  rk_krig_se %>%
    mutate(
      variable = recode(variable, !!!soil_var_labels),
      variable = factor(variable, levels = soil_var_labels),
      dataset  = factor(
        recode(dataset,
               "SP"   = "Single-Point",
               "COMP" = "Composite"),
        levels = c("Single-Point", "Composite")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(variable, dataset, pred_method,
           metric_type, median_unc, pred_method_label),

  # RK total SE — QRF PI + kriging
  rk_total_se_qrf

) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_method_label = factor(
      pred_method_label,
      levels = c("RF",
                 "OK",
                 "RK (kriging SE only)",
                 "RK (total SE)")
    ),
    metric_type = factor(
      metric_type,
      levels = c("QRF 80% PI width", "Kriging SE")
    )
  )

# Convert QRF 80% PI width to approximate SE
# 80% PI = ±1.28 SD on each side = 2.56 SD total
# Therefore SE ≈ PI_width / 2.56

rk_total_uncertainty_corrected <- bind_rows(
  qrf_uncertainty_SP %>%
    select(x, y, ends_with("_pi_width")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "qrf_pi") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_pi_width"),
           dataset  = "SP") %>%
    left_join(
      krig_var_SP %>%
        select(x, y, ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
        pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                     names_to  = "variable",
                     values_to = "krig_var") %>%
        mutate(variable = str_remove(variable,
                                      "_rk_krig_var"),
               dataset  = "SP"),
      by = c("x", "y", "variable", "dataset")
    ),

  qrf_uncertainty_COMP %>%
    select(x, y, ends_with("_pi_width")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "qrf_pi") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(variable, "_pi_width"),
           dataset  = "COMP") %>%
    left_join(
      krig_var_COMP %>%
        select(x, y, ends_with("_rk_krig_var")) %>%
        pivot_longer(-c(x, y),
                     names_to  = "variable",
                     values_to = "krig_var") %>%
        mutate(variable = str_remove(variable,
                                      "_rk_krig_var"),
               dataset  = "COMP"),
      by = c("x", "y", "variable", "dataset")
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert QRF PI width to approximate SE
    # 80% PI = z(0.90) - z(0.10) = 1.282 - (-1.282) = 2.564 SD
    qrf_se      = qrf_pi / 2.564,

    # Combine in quadrature on SE scale
    rk_total_se = sqrt(qrf_se^2 + coalesce(krig_var, 0)),

    # Convert back to PI scale for interpretability
    # multiply by 2.564 to report as 80% PI equivalent
    rk_total_pi = rk_total_se * 2.564
  )

# ── Summarise ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    median_rk_total_pi = round(median(rk_total_pi, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pred_method = "RK")

# ============================================================
# PHASE 6 — UMAP + HDBSCAN Management Zone Delineation
# ============================================================

```{r umap-hdbscan}
run_umap_hdbscan <- function(pred_df,
                              methods          = c("RF", "RK"),
                              soil_vars,
                              include_lags     = FALSE,
                              n_components     = 2,
                              min_dist         = 0.001,
                              n_neighbors      = 30,
                              minPts           = 50,
                              cluster_eps      = 0,
                              label            = "dataset") {

  col_names <- as.vector(outer(soil_vars, methods, paste, sep = "_"))
  if (include_lags) {
    lag_cols  <- paste0(col_names, "_lag")
    col_names <- c(col_names, lag_cols[lag_cols %in% names(pred_df)])
  }
  col_names <- col_names[col_names %in% names(pred_df)]

  mat           <- pred_df %>% select(all_of(col_names)) %>% as.matrix()
  complete_rows <- complete.cases(mat)
  mat_clean     <- mat[complete_rows, ]
  xy_clean      <- pred_df %>% select(x, y) %>% slice(which(complete_rows))

  cat(label, "— pixels:", nrow(mat_clean),
      "| cols:", ncol(mat_clean),
      "| lags:", include_lags, "\n")

  # Zero-variance guard
  col_ranges <- apply(mat_clean, 2, function(x)
                      diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  zero_var   <- col_ranges < 1e-10

  if (any(zero_var)) {
    cat("Warning: dropping", sum(zero_var), "constant column(s):",
        paste(colnames(mat_clean)[zero_var], collapse = ", "), "\n")
    mat_clean <- mat_clean[, !zero_var, drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (ncol(mat_clean) < 2) {
    cat("ERROR: fewer than 2 valid columns for", label, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  mat_scaled <- scale(mat_clean)
  mat_scaled[!is.finite(mat_scaled)] <- 0
  stopifnot("NA values remain" = !anyNA(mat_scaled))

  cat("Fitting UMAP...\n")
  umap_fit <- uwot::umap(
    mat_scaled,
    n_components = n_components,
    min_dist     = min_dist,
    n_neighbors  = n_neighbors,
    ret_model    = TRUE,
    seed         = 20260401,
    verbose      = TRUE
  )

  emb_df        <- as.data.frame(umap_fit$embedding)
  names(emb_df) <- paste0("UMAP", seq_len(n_components))

  hdbscan_sample_size <- min(nrow(emb_df), 10000)
  set.seed(20260401)
  sample_idx <- sort(sample(nrow(emb_df), hdbscan_sample_size))
  emb_sample <- emb_df[sample_idx, ]

  cat("Running HDBSCAN on subsample of", hdbscan_sample_size,
      "points...\n")
  hdb_fit <- dbscan::hdbscan(
    as.matrix(emb_sample),
    minPts                    = minPts,
    cluster_selection_epsilon = cluster_eps
  )

  cat("Clusters on subsample:", max(hdb_fit$cluster),
      "| noise:", round(mean(hdb_fit$cluster == 0) * 100, 1), "%\n")

  nn_assign     <- FNN::get.knnx(
    data  = as.matrix(emb_sample),
    query = as.matrix(emb_df),
    k     = 1
  )
  full_clusters <- hdb_fit$cluster[nn_assign$nn.index[, 1]]
  full_memb     <- hdb_fit$membership_prob[nn_assign$nn.index[, 1]]

  cat("Full grid — zones:", max(full_clusters),
      "| noise:", round(mean(full_clusters == 0) * 100, 1), "%\n")

  bind_cols(
    xy_clean, emb_df,
    tibble(cluster_hard    = full_clusters,
           membership_prob = full_memb)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset      = label,
      spatial_lags = include_lags,
      zone         = if_else(cluster_hard == 0L, NA_integer_,
                             as.integer(cluster_hard))
    )
}

wrap_mz_result <- function(df) {
  if (is.data.frame(df)) {
    zones <- df$zone[!is.na(df$zone)]
    return(list(result_df   = df,
                n_zones     = length(unique(zones)),
                pct_noise   = mean(is.na(df$zone)) * 100,
                umap_fit    = NULL,
                hdbscan_fit = NULL))
  }
  zones <- df$result_df$zone[!is.na(df$result_df$zone)]
  df$n_zones   <- length(unique(zones))
  df$pct_noise <- mean(is.na(df$result_df$zone)) * 100
  df
}

# ============================================================
# PHASE 6c — HDBSCAN Retuning
# ============================================================

```{r hdbscan-retune}
retune_hdbscan <- function(mz_obj, minPts_new,
                            cluster_eps = 0,
                            hdbscan_n   = 10000,
                            label       = NULL) {

  emb_df       <- mz_obj$result_df %>% select(UMAP1, UMAP2)
  xy_clean     <- mz_obj$result_df %>% select(x, y)
  spatial_lags <- mz_obj$result_df$spatial_lags[1]
  lbl          <- if (!is.null(label)) label else
                    mz_obj$result_df$dataset[1]

  set.seed(20260401)
  sample_idx <- sort(sample(nrow(emb_df),
                             min(hdbscan_n, nrow(emb_df))))
  emb_sample <- emb_df[sample_idx, ]

  cat("Retuning:", lbl, "| minPts =", minPts_new, "...\n")
  hdb_fit <- dbscan::hdbscan(
    as.matrix(emb_sample),
    minPts                    = minPts_new,
    cluster_selection_epsilon = cluster_eps
  )

  nn_assign     <- FNN::get.knnx(
    data  = as.matrix(emb_sample),
    query = as.matrix(emb_df),
    k     = 1
  )
  full_clusters <- hdb_fit$cluster[nn_assign$nn.index[, 1]]
  full_memb     <- hdb_fit$membership_prob[nn_assign$nn.index[, 1]]

  result_df <- bind_cols(
    xy_clean, emb_df,
    tibble(cluster_hard = full_clusters,
           membership_prob = full_memb)
  ) %>%
    mutate(dataset      = lbl,
           spatial_lags = spatial_lags,
           zone         = if_else(cluster_hard == 0L,
                                  NA_integer_,
                                  as.integer(cluster_hard)))

  list(result_df   = result_df,
       hdbscan_fit = hdb_fit,
       n_zones     = length(unique(full_clusters[full_clusters != 0])),
       pct_noise   = mean(full_clusters == 0) * 100)
}

# ── Sensitivity scan ──────────────────────────────────────
minpts_candidates <- c(50, 100, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000)

sensitivity_results <- purrr::map_dfr(minpts_candidates, function(mp) {
  purrr::map_dfr(names(mz_named_tuned), function(nm) {
    r <- retune_hdbscan(mz_named_tuned[[nm]], mp, label = nm)
    tibble(label = nm, minPts = mp,
           n_zones = r$n_zones, pct_noise = round(r$pct_noise, 1))
  })
})

```{r post-processing}
post_process_zones <- function(result_df, zone_rast_crs = "EPSG:26917") {
  n_total <- nrow(result_df)
  n_noise <- sum(is.na(result_df$zone))
  cat("Noise pixels before fill:", n_noise,
      "(", round(100 * n_noise / n_total, 1), "% of field)\n")

  if (n_noise == n_total) {
    cat("WARNING: all pixels are noise — no zones found.\n")
    return(list(result_df_filled = result_df,
                zone_rast_raw    = NULL,
                zone_rast_smooth = NULL))
  }

  assigned  <- result_df %>% filter(!is.na(zone))
  noise_pts <- result_df %>% filter( is.na(zone))

  if (nrow(noise_pts) > 0) {
    nn_idx <- FNN::get.knnx(
      data  = assigned  %>% select(UMAP1, UMAP2) %>% as.matrix(),
      query = noise_pts %>% select(UMAP1, UMAP2) %>% as.matrix(),
      k     = 1
    )$nn.index
    noise_pts$zone            <- assigned$zone[nn_idx]
    noise_pts$membership_prob <- 0
    result_df <- bind_rows(assigned, noise_pts)
  }

  cat("Noise pixels after fill: 0\n")

  zone_rast        <- result_df %>%
    select(x, y, zone) %>%
    rast(type = "xyz", crs = zone_rast_crs)
  zone_rast_smooth <- focal(zone_rast, w = 5,
                             fun = "modal", na.rm = TRUE)

  changed <- sum(values(zone_rast) != values(zone_rast_smooth),
                 na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Pixels reassigned by majority filter:", changed,
      "(", round(100 * changed / n_total, 1), "% of field)\n")

  list(result_df_filled = result_df,
       zone_rast_raw    = zone_rast,
       zone_rast_smooth = zone_rast_smooth)
}

pp_named <- purrr::imap(mz_named_tuned, function(x, nm) {
  cat("\n---", nm, "---\n")
  post_process_zones(x$result_df)
})

write_zone_raster <- function(pp_obj, path) {
  if (is.null(pp_obj$zone_rast_smooth)) {
    cat("Skipping", path, "— no zones\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  writeRaster(pp_obj$zone_rast_smooth, path, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Saved:", path, "\n")
}

purrr::iwalk(pp_named, function(pp, nm) {
  write_zone_raster(pp, paste0("../outputs/zones_", nm, "_smooth.tif"))
})

plot_umap_zones <- function(res, title) {
  res$result_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = factor(zone),
               alpha = membership_prob)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.2, 1)) +

         alpha = "Membership\nconfidence") +

      override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

}

}

                            as.integer(-1L), zone)) %>%

      summarise(

        mean_memb_prob    = round(mean(membership_prob,

          100 * mean(membership_prob < 0.3,
                     na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(configuration = nm)
  }
)

        y        = "Northing"
      )

    cat(nm, "— error:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")

# ============================================================
# PHASE 7 — Baseline Comparison: PCA + k-means (elbow k)
# ============================================================

```{r pca-kmeans-baseline}
# ── Define run_pca_kmeans_wcss ─────────────────────────────
run_pca_kmeans_wcss <- function(pred_df,
                                 methods   = c("RF", "RK"),
                                 soil_vars,
                                 include_lags = FALSE,  # new arg
                                 k_range   = 2:15,
                                 label     = "dataset") {
  col_names <- as.vector(outer(soil_vars, methods,
                                paste, sep = "_"))
  # Add lag columns if requested
  if (include_lags) {
    lag_cols  <- paste0(col_names, "_lag")
    col_names <- c(col_names,
                   lag_cols[lag_cols %in% names(pred_df)])
  }
  col_names <- col_names[col_names %in% names(pred_df)]
  mat           <- pred_df %>%
    select(all_of(col_names)) %>% as.matrix()
  complete_rows <- complete.cases(mat)
  xy_clean      <- pred_df %>%
    select(x, y) %>% slice(which(complete_rows))

  mat_scaled <- scale(mat[complete_rows, ])
  col_ranges <- apply(mat_scaled, 2, function(x)
    diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  const_cols <- !is.finite(mat_scaled[1, ]) |
    col_ranges < 1e-10
  if (any(const_cols)) {
    mat_scaled <- mat_scaled[, !const_cols, drop = FALSE]
  }
  mat_scaled[!is.finite(mat_scaled)] <- 0

  pca_out    <- prcomp(mat_scaled,
                        center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  cum_var    <- cumsum(pca_out$sdev^2) /
    sum(pca_out$sdev^2)
  n_comp     <- which(cum_var >= 0.95)[1]
  pca_scores <- pca_out$x[, seq_len(n_comp), drop = FALSE]

  set.seed(20260401)
  sil_idx <- sample(nrow(pca_scores),
                    min(5000, nrow(pca_scores)))
  pca_sub <- pca_scores[sil_idx, ]

  # ── Compute WCSS across k range ───────────────────────
  wcss_vals <- purrr::map_dbl(k_range, function(k) {
    set.seed(20260401)
    km <- kmeans(pca_sub, centers = k,
                 nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
    km$tot.withinss
  })

  # ── Kneedle algorithm ─────────────────────────────────
  x      <- k_range
  y      <- wcss_vals
  x_norm <- (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  y_norm <- (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y))
  n      <- length(x_norm)
  x1 <- x_norm[1]; y1 <- y_norm[1]
  x2 <- x_norm[n]; y2 <- y_norm[n]
  dist_to_line <- abs(
    (y2 - y1) * x_norm -
      (x2 - x1) * y_norm +
      x2 * y1 - y2 * x1
  ) / sqrt((y2 - y1)^2 + (x2 - x1)^2)
  best_k <- x[which.max(dist_to_line)]

  cat(label, "— elbow k:", best_k, "\n")

  # ── Fit final kmeans with elbow k ─────────────────────
  set.seed(20260401)
  km_best <- kmeans(pca_scores,
                    centers  = best_k,
                    nstart   = 25,
                    iter.max = 100)

  result_df <- bind_cols(
    xy_clean,
    tibble(zone_kmeans = km_best$cluster)
  ) %>% mutate(dataset = label, method = "PCA_kmeans")

  list(
    result_df    = result_df,
    pca          = pca_out,
    km           = km_best,
    wcss_profile = tibble(k = k_range,
                           wcss = wcss_vals),
    best_k       = best_k,
    elbow_k      = best_k
  )
}

# ── Run all 10 configurations with elbow k detection ──────

        legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),

```{r pca-kmeans-postprocess}
post_process_kmeans <- function(result_df,
                                 zone_rast_crs = "EPSG:26917") {
  n_total   <- nrow(result_df)
  zone_rast <- result_df %>%
    select(x, y, zone = zone_kmeans) %>%
    rast(type = "xyz", crs = zone_rast_crs)

  zone_rast_smooth <- focal(zone_rast, w = 5,
                             fun = "modal", na.rm = TRUE)
  changed <- sum(values(zone_rast) != values(zone_rast_smooth),
                 na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("PCA+kmeans: pixels reassigned by majority filter:", changed,
      "(", round(100 * changed / n_total, 1), "%)\n")

  list(result_df_filled = result_df %>% mutate(zone = zone_kmeans),
       zone_rast_raw    = zone_rast,
       zone_rast_smooth = zone_rast_smooth)
}

# ── Post-process all elbow configurations ─────────────────
pp_baseline <- list(
  SP_RF        = post_process_kmeans(baseline_SP_RF_elbow$result_df),
  SP_RK        = post_process_kmeans(baseline_SP_RK_elbow$result_df),
  SP_OK        = post_process_kmeans(baseline_SP_OK_elbow$result_df),
  COMP_RF      = post_process_kmeans(baseline_COMP_RF_elbow$result_df),
  COMP_RK      = post_process_kmeans(baseline_COMP_RK_elbow$result_df),
  COMP_OK      = post_process_kmeans(baseline_COMP_OK_elbow$result_df),
  SP_RF_lags   = post_process_kmeans(baseline_SP_RF_lags_elbow$result_df),
  SP_RK_lags   = post_process_kmeans(baseline_SP_RK_lags_elbow$result_df),
  COMP_RF_lags = post_process_kmeans(baseline_COMP_RF_lags_elbow$result_df),
  COMP_RK_lags = post_process_kmeans(baseline_COMP_RK_lags_elbow$result_df)
)

purrr::iwalk(pp_baseline, function(pp, nm) {

  })

# ── Metric functions ──────────────────────────────────────
calc_variance_reduction <- function(pred_df, zone_vec,
                                     soil_vars, methods) {
  col_names  <- as.vector(outer(soil_vars, methods, paste, sep = "_"))
  col_names  <- col_names[col_names %in% names(pred_df)]
  mat        <- pred_df %>% select(all_of(col_names)) %>% as.matrix()
  col_ranges <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) diff(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  mat        <- mat[, col_ranges > 1e-10, drop = FALSE]
  keep       <- !is.na(zone_vec) & complete.cases(mat)
  mat_k      <- mat[keep, ]
  zones_k    <- zone_vec[keep]
  total_var  <- mean(apply(mat_k, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE))
  within_var <- mean(sapply(unique(zones_k), function(z) {
    mean(apply(mat_k[zones_k == z, , drop = FALSE],
               2, var, na.rm = TRUE))
  }))
  1 - (within_var / total_var)
}

calc_silhouette_sub <- function(emb_df, zone_vec, n_sub = 5000) {
  keep  <- !is.na(zone_vec)
  emb_k <- emb_df[keep, ]
  z_k   <- zone_vec[keep]
  set.seed(20260401)
  idx   <- sample(nrow(emb_k), min(n_sub, nrow(emb_k)))
  sil   <- cluster::silhouette(z_k[idx], dist(emb_k[idx, ]))
  mean(sil[, 3])
}

# ── UMAP VR + silhouette ──────────────────────────────────
zone_validation_umap <- purrr::imap_dfr(mz_named_tuned,
  function(x, nm) {
    parts  <- strsplit(nm, "_")[[1]]
    samp   <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
    lag_yn <- length(parts) >= 3 && parts[3] == "lags"
    pred_df <- switch(paste0(samp, "_", method),
      SP_RF   = pred_stack_SP,   SP_RK   = pred_stack_SP,
      SP_OK   = pred_stack_SP,   COMP_RF = pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_RK = pred_stack_COMP, COMP_OK = pred_stack_COMP)
    tibble(
      configuration = nm, sampling = samp,
      pred_method   = method, lags = lag_yn,
      approach      = "UMAP+HDBSCAN",
      VR = calc_variance_reduction(
        pred_df, x$result_df$zone, soil_vars, method),
      silhouette = calc_silhouette_sub(
        x$result_df %>% select(UMAP1, UMAP2),
        x$result_df$zone)
    )
  })

# ── PCA+kmeans VR + silhouette — elbow objects ────────────
baseline_list <- list(
  SP_RF               = baseline_SP_RF_elbow,
  SP_RK               = baseline_SP_RK_elbow,
  SP_OK               = baseline_SP_OK_elbow,
  COMP_RF             = baseline_COMP_RF_elbow,
  COMP_RK             = baseline_COMP_RK_elbow,
  COMP_OK             = baseline_COMP_OK_elbow,
  SP_RF_lags_kmeans   = baseline_SP_RF_lags_elbow,
  SP_RK_lags_kmeans   = baseline_SP_RK_lags_elbow,
  COMP_RF_lags_kmeans = baseline_COMP_RF_lags_elbow,
  COMP_RK_lags_kmeans = baseline_COMP_RK_lags_elbow
)

zone_validation_pca <- purrr::imap_dfr(baseline_list,
  function(b, nm) {
    clean   <- str_remove(nm, "_kmeans")
    has_lag <- str_detect(clean, "_lags")
    clean   <- str_remove(clean, "_lags")
    parts   <- strsplit(clean, "_")[[1]]
    samp    <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
    pred_df <- switch(paste0(samp, "_", method),
      SP_RF   = if (has_lag) pred_stack_SP_lag   else pred_stack_SP,
      SP_RK   = if (has_lag) pred_stack_SP_lag   else pred_stack_SP,
      SP_OK   = pred_stack_SP,
      COMP_RF = if (has_lag) pred_stack_COMP_lag else pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_RK = if (has_lag) pred_stack_COMP_lag else pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_OK = pred_stack_COMP)
    ok_cols  <- pred_df %>%
      select(any_of(paste0(soil_vars, "_", method))) %>% na.omit()
    col_vars <- apply(ok_cols, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
    ok_cols  <- ok_cols[, col_vars > 1e-10, drop = FALSE]
    tibble(
      configuration = nm, sampling = samp,
      pred_method   = method, lags = has_lag,
      approach      = "PCA+kmeans",
      VR = calc_variance_reduction(
        pred_df, b$result_df$zone_kmeans, soil_vars, method),
      silhouette = calc_silhouette_sub(
        prcomp(scale(ok_cols), center = FALSE)$x[, 1:2],
        b$result_df$zone_kmeans)
    )
  })

# ── Combine ───────────────────────────────────────────────
zone_validation_all <- bind_rows(zone_validation_umap,
                                   zone_validation_pca) %>%
  arrange(sampling, pred_method, lags, approach)

print(zone_validation_all)
write_csv(zone_validation_all,
          "../outputs/zone_validation_metrics.csv")

validate_zones_with_holdout <- function(zone_rast_smooth, val_sf,
                                        pred_stack, soil_vars,
                                        methods = c("RF", "RK"),
                                        label = "dataset") {
  val_vect    <- terra::vect(val_sf)
  val_zone    <- terra::extract(zone_rast_smooth, val_vect)
  val_sf$zone <- val_zone[, 2]

  n_assigned <- sum(!is.na(val_sf$zone))
  cat(label, "— validation points with zone assignment:",
      n_assigned, "of", nrow(val_sf), "\n")

  col_names <- as.vector(outer(soil_vars, methods, paste, sep = "_"))
  col_names <- col_names[col_names %in% names(pred_stack)]

  pred_pts  <- terra::vect(
    pred_stack %>% select(x, y),
    geom = c("x", "y"), crs = "EPSG:26917"
  )
  pred_zone_extract <- terra::extract(zone_rast_smooth, pred_pts, ID = FALSE)
  pred_stack_zoned  <- pred_stack %>%
    mutate(zone = pred_zone_extract[[1]])

  zone_profiles <- pred_stack_zoned %>%
    filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
    group_by(zone) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(col_names), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")

  val_long <- val_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
    select(zone, all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-zone, names_to = "variable", values_to = "obs")

  method_suffix <- paste0("_", methods[1])

  pred_long <- zone_profiles %>%
    select(zone, ends_with(method_suffix)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-zone, names_to = "col", values_to = "pred_zone_mean") %>%
    mutate(variable = str_remove(col, method_suffix)) %>%
    select(zone, variable, pred_zone_mean)

  comparison <- val_long %>%
    left_join(pred_long, by = c("zone", "variable")) %>%
    group_by(zone, variable) %>%
    summarise(
      n_val_pts      = n(),
      mean_obs       = mean(obs,                            na.rm = TRUE),
      pred_zone_mean = first(pred_zone_mean),
      bias           = mean(obs - pred_zone_mean,           na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse_vs_zone   = sqrt(mean((obs - pred_zone_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = label)

  kw_results <- purrr::map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
    df <- val_sf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      filter(!is.na(zone), !is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
      select(zone, value = all_of(v))

    if (length(unique(df$zone)) < 2 || nrow(df) < 5) {
      return(tibble(variable = v, kw_p = NA_real_, dataset = label))
    }
    kt <- kruskal.test(value ~ factor(zone), data = df)
    tibble(variable = v, kw_p = kt$p.value, dataset = label)
  })

  list(comparison     = comparison,
       kw_results     = kw_results,
       val_with_zones = val_sf)
}

get_pred_stack <- function(nm) {
  clean   <- nm %>%
    str_remove("_kmeans") %>%
    str_remove("_nolags") %>%
    str_remove("_lags")
  parts   <- strsplit(clean, "_")[[1]]
  samp    <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
  has_lag <- str_detect(nm, "_lags")

  pred_df <- switch(paste0(samp, "_", method),
    SP_RF   = if (has_lag) pred_stack_SP_lag   else pred_stack_SP,
    SP_RK   = if (has_lag) pred_stack_SP_lag   else pred_stack_SP,
    SP_OK   = pred_stack_SP,
    COMP_RF = if (has_lag) pred_stack_COMP_lag else pred_stack_COMP,
    COMP_RK = if (has_lag) pred_stack_COMP_lag else pred_stack_COMP,
    COMP_OK = pred_stack_COMP)

  list(pred_df = pred_df, method = method,
       samp = samp, has_lag = has_lag)
}

val_umap <- purrr::imap(pp_named, function(pp, nm) {

    cfg$pred_df, soil_vars,
    methods = cfg$method, label = nm)
})

})

    approach    = if_else(str_detect(dataset, "_kmeans"),

    clean       = dataset %>%
                    str_remove("_kmeans") %>%
                    str_remove("_nolags") %>%

    sampling    = str_extract(clean, "^(SP|COMP)"),

```{r observed-vr-and-effect-sizes}
calc_zone_consistency <- function(val_with_zones, soil_vars, label) {
  df <- val_with_zones %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
    select(zone, all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
    na.omit()

  if (nrow(df) < 5 || length(unique(df$zone)) < 2) {
    return(tibble(configuration    = label,
                  observed_VR_mean = NA_real_,
                  observed_VR_med  = NA_real_,
                  n_pos_VR         = NA_integer_))
  }

  total_var_vec <- df %>%
    select(all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    unlist()

  per_var_vr <- purrr::map_dbl(soil_vars, function(v) {
    within_var <- df %>%
      group_by(zone) %>%
      summarise(wv = var(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pull(wv) %>%
      mean(na.rm = TRUE)
    1 - (within_var / total_var_vec[[v]])
  })
  names(per_var_vr) <- soil_vars

  tibble(configuration    = label,
         observed_VR_mean = round(mean(per_var_vr,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
         observed_VR_med  = round(median(per_var_vr, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
         n_pos_VR         = sum(per_var_vr > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
}

obs_vr_all <- bind_rows(
  purrr::imap_dfr(val_named,  ~ calc_zone_consistency(
    .x$val_with_zones, soil_vars, .y)) %>%
    rename(config_join = configuration),
  purrr::imap_dfr(val_kmeans, ~ calc_zone_consistency(
    .x$val_with_zones, soil_vars, paste0(.y, "_kmeans"))) %>%
    rename(config_join = configuration)
)

zone_pred_rmse <- all_comparisons_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(rmse_vs_zone)) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_zone_rmse   = round(mean(rmse_vs_zone,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median_zone_rmse = round(median(rmse_vs_zone, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups          = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(config_join = dataset)

zone_r2 <- all_comparisons_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(pred_zone_mean), !is.na(mean_obs)) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    r2_obs_pred = round(
      cor(mean_obs, pred_zone_mean, use = "complete.obs")^2, 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(config_join = dataset)

obs_vr_by_var_all <- bind_rows(
  purrr::imap_dfr(val_named, function(x, nm) {
    df <- x$val_with_zones %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
      filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
      select(zone, all_of(soil_vars)) %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 5 || length(unique(df$zone)) < 2) return(NULL)
    tv <- df %>% select(all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
      summarise(across(everything(), ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% unlist()
    purrr::map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
      wv <- df %>% group_by(zone) %>%
        summarise(wv = var(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(wv) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
      tibble(configuration = nm, variable = v,
             obs_VR = round(1 - wv / tv[[v]], 3))
    })
  }),
  purrr::imap_dfr(val_kmeans, function(x, nm) {
    df <- x$val_with_zones %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
      filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
      select(zone, all_of(soil_vars)) %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 5 || length(unique(df$zone)) < 2) return(NULL)
    tv <- df %>% select(all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
      summarise(across(everything(), ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% unlist()
    purrr::map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
      wv <- df %>% group_by(zone) %>%
        summarise(wv = var(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(wv) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
      tibble(configuration = paste0(nm, "_kmeans"), variable = v,
             obs_VR = round(1 - wv / tv[[v]], 3))
    })
  })
)

# Supplementary VR heatmap
p_obs_vr <- obs_vr_by_var_all %>%
  left_join(
    bind_rows(
      zone_validation_umap %>%
        select(configuration, clustering = approach),
      zone_validation_pca %>%
        mutate(configuration = if_else(
          !str_detect(configuration, "_kmeans"),
          paste0(configuration, "_kmeans"),
          configuration)) %>%

    ),
    by = "configuration"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    config_label = str_replace_all(
      configuration,
      c("_nolags" = "", "_lags" = "+lags",
        "_kmeans" = "", "COMP_" = "COMP/", "SP_" = "SP/")),
    clustering = if_else(
      is.na(clustering),
      if_else(str_detect(configuration, "_kmeans"),
              "PCA+kmeans", "UMAP+HDBSCAN"), clustering),
    approach = factor(clustering,
                      levels = c("PCA+kmeans", "UMAP+HDBSCAN"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = config_label, y = variable, fill = obs_VR)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", obs_VR)), size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ approach, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027", mid = "#ffffbf", high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1),
    oob = scales::squish, name = "Observed VR"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid       = element_blank()) +
  labs(title    = "Supplementary Figure S1. Per-variable observed variance reduction",
       subtitle = "Held-out validation points (n = 59), fully independent of prediction surfaces",
       x = NULL, y = "Soil variable")

# ── Build summary tables ───────────────────────────────────
summary_umap <- purrr::imap_dfr(mz_named_tuned, function(x, nm) {
  parts  <- strsplit(nm, "_")[[1]]
  samp   <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
  lag_yn <- length(parts) >= 3 && parts[3] == "lags"
  tibble(configuration     = nm,
         clustering        = "UMAP+HDBSCAN",
         sampling_design   = ifelse(samp == "SP", "Single-point", "Composite"),
         pred_method       = method,
         spatial_lags      = lag_yn,
         minPts_used       = minpts_final[[nm]],
         n_zones           = x$n_zones,
         pct_noise_prefill = round(x$pct_noise, 1))
}) %>%
  left_join(
    all_kw %>% filter(approach == "UMAP+HDBSCAN") %>%
      group_by(dataset) %>%
      summarise(n_sig_vars = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
                sig_vars   = paste(variable[significant], collapse = ", "),
                .groups    = "drop") %>%
      rename(configuration = dataset),
    by = "configuration"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_sig_vars = replace_na(n_sig_vars, 0L),
    sig_vars   = replace_na(sig_vars,   "none"),
    sig_vars   = ifelse(sig_vars == "" | is.na(sig_vars), "none", sig_vars)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    zone_validation_all %>% filter(approach == "UMAP+HDBSCAN") %>%
      select(configuration, VR, silhouette),
    by = "configuration"
  )

# ── PCA summary — elbow baseline_list ─────────────────────
summary_pca <- purrr::imap_dfr(baseline_list, function(b, nm) {
  clean   <- str_remove(nm, "_kmeans")
  has_lag <- str_detect(clean, "_lags")
  clean   <- str_remove(clean, "_lags")
  parts   <- strsplit(clean, "_")[[1]]
  samp    <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
  tibble(configuration     = nm,
         clustering        = "PCA+kmeans",
         sampling_design   = ifelse(samp == "SP", "Single-point", "Composite"),
         pred_method       = method,
         spatial_lags      = has_lag,
         minPts_used       = NA_real_,
         n_zones           = b$best_k,   # elbow k stored as best_k
         pct_noise_prefill = 0)
}) %>%
  left_join(
    all_kw %>% filter(approach == "PCA+kmeans") %>%
      group_by(dataset) %>%
      summarise(n_sig_vars = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
                sig_vars   = paste(variable[significant], collapse = ", "),
                .groups    = "drop") %>%
      rename(configuration = dataset),
    by = "configuration"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_sig_vars = replace_na(n_sig_vars, 0L),
    sig_vars   = replace_na(sig_vars,   "none"),
    sig_vars   = ifelse(sig_vars == "" | is.na(sig_vars), "none", sig_vars)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    zone_validation_all %>% filter(approach == "PCA+kmeans") %>%
      select(configuration, VR, silhouette),
    by = "configuration"
  )

# ── Join all metrics ───────────────────────────────────────
final_summary <- bind_rows(summary_umap, summary_pca) %>%
  mutate(
    config_join = case_when(
      clustering == "PCA+kmeans" &
        !str_detect(configuration, "_kmeans") ~
        paste0(configuration, "_kmeans"),
      TRUE ~ configuration
    ),
    sig_vars = ifelse(sig_vars == "" | is.na(sig_vars), "none", sig_vars)
  ) %>%
  left_join(zone_pred_rmse, by = "config_join") %>%
  left_join(obs_vr_all,     by = "config_join") %>%
  left_join(zone_r2 %>% select(config_join, r2_obs_pred),
            by = "config_join") %>%
  select(-config_join)

# ── Composite score: normalized 0–1, higher = better ──────
normalize_higher <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
}

normalize_lower <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (rng[2] - x) / diff(rng)
}

final_ranked <- final_summary %>%
  mutate(
    s_vr_pred = normalize_higher(VR),
    s_sil     = normalize_higher(silhouette),
    s_nsig    = normalize_higher(n_sig_vars),
    s_rmse    = normalize_lower(median_zone_rmse),
    s_vr_obs  = normalize_higher(observed_VR_med),
    s_npos    = normalize_higher(n_pos_VR),
    s_r2      = normalize_higher(r2_obs_pred),
    Score     = round(
      rowMeans(cbind(s_vr_pred, s_sil, s_nsig,
                     s_rmse,    s_vr_obs, s_npos,
                     s_r2),
               na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  ) %>%
  select(configuration, Score)

# ── Print ranking ──────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Composite score — all configurations (higher = better) ===\n")
final_summary %>%
  left_join(final_ranked, by = "configuration") %>%
  arrange(desc(Score)) %>%
  select(configuration, clustering, VR, silhouette,
         n_sig_vars, median_zone_rmse,
         observed_VR_med, n_pos_VR, r2_obs_pred, Score) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = 20)

write_csv(final_summary, "../outputs/final_results_summary_complete.csv")

# ── Build table_data ──────────────────────────────────────
table_data <- final_summary %>%
  left_join(final_ranked, by = "configuration") %>%
  mutate(
    Approach  = clustering,
    Sampling  = ifelse(sampling_design == "Single-point", "SP", "COMP"),
    Method    = pred_method,
    Lags      = ifelse(spatial_lags, "Yes", "No"),
    Zones     = n_zones,
    VR_pred   = round(VR,               3),
    Sil       = round(silhouette,       3),
    N_sig_pct = round(100 * n_sig_vars / length(soil_vars), 1),
    RMSE_zone = round(median_zone_rmse, 1),
    VR_obs    = round(observed_VR_med,  3),
    N_pos     = n_pos_VR,
    R2        = round(r2_obs_pred,      3)
  ) %>%
  select(Approach, Sampling, Method, Lags, Zones,
         VR_pred, Sil, N_sig_pct, RMSE_zone,
         VR_obs, N_pos, R2, Score) %>%
  arrange(Approach, Sampling, Method, Lags)

# ── Best values per column ────────────────────────────────
best <- list(
  VR_pred   = max(table_data$VR_pred,   na.rm = TRUE),
  Sil       = max(table_data$Sil,       na.rm = TRUE),
  N_sig_pct = max(table_data$N_sig_pct, na.rm = TRUE),

  R2        = max(table_data$R2,        na.rm = TRUE),
  Score     = max(table_data$Score,     na.rm = TRUE)
)

# ── gt table ──────────────────────────────────────────────

<!-- The three key changes from the original are: -->

<!-- **Phase 7** — `run_pca_kmeans` (silhouette) is dropped entirely and replaced with `run_pca_kmeans_wcss` (elbow) calls. All `baseline_*` objects are now `baseline_*_elbow`. `pp_baseline` is rebuilt from elbow result_dfs. The silhouette profile plot is replaced by the WCSS elbow plot with detected k marked. -->
  
  <!-- **Phase 8** — `baseline_list` now points to all `*_elbow` objects. Everything downstream (VR, silhouette score, KW, RMSE, R², composite rank) is identical in structure since `result_df` and `zone_rast_smooth` have the same format regardless of k selection method. -->

# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — Fixed k=6 for all configurations
# ============================================================
  # Controls for zone count across all methods and sampling designs
  # to enable equal-comparison of clustering approaches
  # All objects use _k6 suffix — nothing is overwritten

```{r fixed-k6-sensitivity}

# ── 1. Helper: fit kmeans at fixed k on existing PCA scores ─
fit_kmeans_fixed_k <- function(elbow_obj, k_fixed = 6,
                                label = "dataset") {
  # Extract PCA scores from existing elbow object
  cum_var    <- cumsum(elbow_obj$pca$sdev^2) /
                  sum(elbow_obj$pca$sdev^2)
  n_comp     <- which(cum_var >= 0.95)[1]
  pca_scores <- elbow_obj$pca$x[,
                  seq_len(n_comp), drop = FALSE]

  set.seed(20260401)
  km <- kmeans(pca_scores,
               centers  = k_fixed,
               nstart   = 25,
               iter.max = 100)

  # Rebuild result_df with same xy as original
  result_df <- elbow_obj$result_df %>%
    select(x, y, dataset, method) %>%
    mutate(zone_kmeans = km$cluster)

  cat(label, "— fixed k =", k_fixed, "\n")

  list(
    result_df = result_df,
    pca       = elbow_obj$pca,
    km        = km,
    best_k    = k_fixed
  )
}

# ── 2. Fit all 10 PCA configs at k=6 ──────────────────────
cat("Fitting PCA+kmeans at fixed k=6...\n")

baseline_SP_RF_k6        <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(

baseline_SP_OK_k6        <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(
