baseline_COMP_RF_k6      <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(
  baseline_COMP_RF_elbow,      6, "COMP_RF")
baseline_COMP_RK_k6      <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(
  baseline_COMP_RK_elbow,      6, "COMP_RK")
baseline_COMP_OK_k6      <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(
  baseline_COMP_OK_elbow,      6, "COMP_OK")

baseline_SP_RK_lags_k6   <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(

baseline_COMP_RK_lags_k6 <- fit_kmeans_fixed_k(

# ── 3. Post-process PCA k=6 zones ─────────────────────────

# ── 4. Retune UMAP+HDBSCAN to k=6 via cluster_eps ────────
# For UMAP we cannot directly set k — instead we retune
# minPts until we get as close to k=6 as possible per config
# Use retune_hdbscan which is already defined

cat("\nRetuning UMAP+HDBSCAN toward k=6...\n")

# Helper: find minPts that gives closest to target k
find_minpts_for_k <- function(mz_source_obj, target_k = 6,
                               nm = "config",
                               candidates = c(50, 75, 100,
                                              150, 200, 300,
                                              400, 600, 800)) {
  results <- purrr::map_dfr(candidates, function(mp) {
    r <- retune_hdbscan(mz_source_obj, mp, label = nm)
    tibble(minPts = mp, n_zones = r$n_zones,
           pct_noise = r$pct_noise,
           diff = abs(r$n_zones - target_k))
  })
  best_row <- results %>%
    arrange(diff, desc(minPts)) %>%   # prefer larger minPts if tie
    slice(1)
  cat(nm, "— best minPts:", best_row$minPts,
      "| k =", best_row$n_zones,
      "| noise:", round(best_row$pct_noise, 1), "%\n")
  best_row$minPts
}

# Find best minPts per config
cat("\nSearching for minPts closest to k=6...\n")
minpts_k6 <- purrr::imap(
  mz_named_tuned,                         # <-- CORRECT
  ~ find_minpts_for_k(.x, target_k = 6, nm = .y)
)


print(tibble(config  = names(minpts_k6),
             minPts  = unlist(minpts_k6)))

# Retune all UMAP configs with best minPts
mz_named_k6 <- purrr::imap(minpts_k6, function(mp, nm) {
  retune_hdbscan(mz_named_source[[nm]], mp, label = nm)
})

mz_named_k6 <- purrr::imap(minpts_k6, function(mp, nm) {
  retune_hdbscan(mz_named_tuned[[nm]],    # <-- CORRECT
                 mp, label = nm)
})
# ── 5. Post-process UMAP k≈6 zones ────────────────────────
pp_named_k6 <- purrr::imap(mz_named_k6, function(x, nm) {
  cat("\n---", nm, "---\n")
  post_process_zones(x$result_df)
})

# Regenerate rasters fresh to avoid pointer issues
pp_named_k6 <- purrr::imap(pp_named_k6, function(pp, nm) {
  if (is.null(pp$result_df_filled)) return(pp)
  tryCatch({
    zone_raw <- pp$result_df_filled %>%
      select(x, y, zone) %>%
      filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
      rast(type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:26917")
    zone_smooth <- focal(zone_raw, w = 5,
                         fun = "modal", na.rm = TRUE)
    pp$zone_rast_raw    <- zone_raw
    pp$zone_rast_smooth <- zone_smooth
    cat(nm, "— raster regenerated\n")
    pp
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(nm, "— error:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); pp
  })
})

pp_baseline_k6 <- purrr::imap(pp_baseline_k6, function(pp, nm) {
  if (is.null(pp$result_df_filled)) return(pp)
  tryCatch({
    zone_raw <- pp$result_df_filled %>%
      select(x, y, zone) %>%
      filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
      rast(type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:26917")
    zone_smooth <- focal(zone_raw, w = 5,
                         fun = "modal", na.rm = TRUE)
    pp$zone_rast_raw    <- zone_raw
    pp$zone_rast_smooth <- zone_smooth
    pp
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(nm, "— error:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); pp
  })
})

# ── 6. Zone structure metrics ─────────────────────────────
# VR_pred and Silhouette for k=6 configs

baseline_list_k6 <- list(
  SP_RF               = baseline_SP_RF_k6,
  SP_RK               = baseline_SP_RK_k6,
  SP_OK               = baseline_SP_OK_k6,
  COMP_RF             = baseline_COMP_RF_k6,
  COMP_RK             = baseline_COMP_RK_k6,
  COMP_OK             = baseline_COMP_OK_k6,
  SP_RF_lags_kmeans   = baseline_SP_RF_lags_k6,
  SP_RK_lags_kmeans   = baseline_SP_RK_lags_k6,
  COMP_RF_lags_kmeans = baseline_COMP_RF_lags_k6,
  COMP_RK_lags_kmeans = baseline_COMP_RK_lags_k6
)

zone_validation_umap_k6 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  mz_named_k6, function(x, nm) {
    parts  <- strsplit(nm, "_")[[1]]
    samp   <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
    lag_yn <- length(parts) >= 3 && parts[3] == "lags"
    pred_df <- switch(paste0(samp, "_", method),
      SP_RF   = pred_stack_SP,
      SP_RK   = pred_stack_SP,
      SP_OK   = pred_stack_SP,
      COMP_RF = pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_RK = pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_OK = pred_stack_COMP)
    tibble(
      configuration = nm, sampling = samp,
      pred_method   = method, lags = lag_yn,
      approach      = "UMAP+HDBSCAN",
      actual_k      = x$n_zones,
      VR = calc_variance_reduction(
        pred_df, x$result_df$zone, soil_vars, method),
      silhouette = calc_silhouette_sub(
        x$result_df %>% select(UMAP1, UMAP2),
        x$result_df$zone)
    )
  })

zone_validation_pca_k6 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  baseline_list_k6, function(b, nm) {
    clean   <- str_remove(nm, "_kmeans")
    has_lag <- str_detect(clean, "_lags")
    clean   <- str_remove(clean, "_lags")
    parts   <- strsplit(clean, "_")[[1]]
    samp    <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
    pred_df <- switch(paste0(samp, "_", method),
      SP_RF   = if (has_lag) pred_stack_SP_lag   else pred_stack_SP,
      SP_RK   = if (has_lag) pred_stack_SP_lag   else pred_stack_SP,
      SP_OK   = pred_stack_SP,
      COMP_RF = if (has_lag) pred_stack_COMP_lag else pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_RK = if (has_lag) pred_stack_COMP_lag else pred_stack_COMP,
      COMP_OK = pred_stack_COMP)
    ok_cols  <- pred_df %>%
      select(any_of(paste0(soil_vars, "_", method))) %>% na.omit()
    col_vars <- apply(ok_cols, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
    ok_cols  <- ok_cols[, col_vars > 1e-10, drop = FALSE]
    tibble(
      configuration = nm, sampling = samp,
      pred_method   = method, lags = has_lag,
      approach      = "PCA+kmeans",
      actual_k      = b$best_k,
      VR = calc_variance_reduction(
        pred_df, b$result_df$zone_kmeans, soil_vars, method),
      silhouette = calc_silhouette_sub(
        prcomp(scale(ok_cols), center = FALSE)$x[, 1:2],
        b$result_df$zone_kmeans)
    )
  })

zone_validation_all_k6 <- bind_rows(
  zone_validation_umap_k6,
  zone_validation_pca_k6)

# ── 7. Agronomic validation ───────────────────────────────
val_umap_k6 <- purrr::imap(pp_named_k6, function(pp, nm) {
  if (is.null(pp$zone_rast_smooth)) {
    cat(nm, "— skipped\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  cfg <- get_pred_stack(nm)
  validate_zones_with_holdout(
    pp$zone_rast_smooth, ap_val_sf,
    cfg$pred_df, soil_vars,
    methods = cfg$method,
    label   = paste0(nm, "_k6"))
})
val_umap_k6 <- val_umap_k6[!sapply(val_umap_k6, is.null)]

# ── Fix: standardise all k6 labels ────────────────────────
# The problem is val_kmeans_k6 lags configs get label
# "SP_RF_lags_kmeans" instead of "SP_RF_lags_kmeans_k6"
# because get_pred_stack strips "_lags" before "_k6" is added

# Check what labels actually exist
cat("val_umap_k6 labels:\n")
print(names(val_umap_k6))
cat("\nval_kmeans_k6 labels:\n")
print(names(val_kmeans_k6))

# Rename any missing _k6 suffixes in val_kmeans_k6
val_kmeans_k6 <- purrr::imap(val_kmeans_k6, function(x, nm) {
  # Fix comparison dataset label if missing _k6
  x$comparison <- x$comparison %>%
    mutate(dataset = if_else(
      !str_detect(dataset, "_k6"),
      paste0(dataset, "_k6"),
      dataset
    ))
  x$kw_results <- x$kw_results %>%
    mutate(dataset = if_else(
      !str_detect(dataset, "_k6"),
      paste0(dataset, "_k6"),
      dataset
    ))
  x
})

# Rename list names too
names(val_kmeans_k6) <- if_else(
  !str_detect(names(val_kmeans_k6), "_k6"),
  paste0(names(val_kmeans_k6), "_k6"),
  names(val_kmeans_k6)
)

cat("\nFixed val_kmeans_k6 labels:\n")
print(names(val_kmeans_k6))

# Now rebuild all_val_k6 with corrected labels
all_val_k6 <- c(val_umap_k6, val_kmeans_k6)

# Rebuild KW with corrected labels
all_kw_k6 <- purrr::map_dfr(all_val_k6, ~ .x$kw_results) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = kw_p < 0.05,
    approach    = if_else(str_detect(dataset, "_kmeans"),
                          "PCA+kmeans", "UMAP+HDBSCAN"),
    clean       = dataset %>%
                    str_remove("_kmeans_k6") %>%
                    str_remove("_k6") %>%
                    str_remove("_nolags") %>%
                    str_remove("_lags"),
    sampling    = str_extract(clean, "^(SP|COMP)"),
    pred_method = str_extract(clean, "(RF|RK|OK)"),
    lags        = str_detect(dataset, "_lags")
  ) %>%
  select(-clean)

all_comparisons_k6      <- purrr::map_dfr(
  val_umap_k6,   ~ .x$comparison)
all_comparisons_pca_k6  <- purrr::map_dfr(
  val_kmeans_k6, ~ .x$comparison)
all_comparisons_full_k6 <- bind_rows(
  all_comparisons_k6, all_comparisons_pca_k6)

cat("\nUnique dataset labels in all_kw_k6:\n")
print(sort(unique(all_kw_k6$dataset)))

# ── Fix: rebuild obs_vr, rmse, r2 with correct join keys ──

# The internal labels in val_kmeans_k6 are like
# "SP_RF_kmeans_k6", "SP_RF_lags_kmeans_k6" etc.
# The internal labels in val_umap_k6 are like
# "SP_RF_nolags_k6", "COMP_RF_lags_k6" etc.
# Use these directly as config_join keys

obs_vr_all_k6 <- bind_rows(

  # UMAP — use list name + _k6 as key
  purrr::imap_dfr(val_umap_k6, function(x, nm) {
    calc_zone_consistency(
      x$val_with_zones, soil_vars,
      label = unique(x$kw_results$dataset)  # use internal label
    )
  }) %>% rename(config_join = configuration),

  # PCA kmeans — use internal dataset label as key
  purrr::imap_dfr(val_kmeans_k6, function(x, nm) {
    calc_zone_consistency(
      x$val_with_zones, soil_vars,
      label = unique(x$kw_results$dataset)  # use internal label
    )
  }) %>% rename(config_join = configuration)
)

zone_pred_rmse_k6 <- all_comparisons_full_k6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(rmse_vs_zone)) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    median_zone_rmse = round(median(rmse_vs_zone,
                                    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(config_join = dataset)

zone_r2_k6 <- all_comparisons_full_k6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(pred_zone_mean), !is.na(mean_obs)) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    r2_obs_pred = round(
      cor(mean_obs, pred_zone_mean,
          use = "complete.obs")^2, 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(config_join = dataset)

# Verify all three now have matching keys
cat("obs_vr keys:\n")
print(sort(unique(obs_vr_all_k6$config_join)))
cat("\nrmse keys:\n")
print(sort(unique(zone_pred_rmse_k6$config_join)))
cat("\nr2 keys:\n")
print(sort(unique(zone_r2_k6$config_join)))

# ── Rebuild final_summary_k6 with corrected join keys ─────
summary_umap_k6 <- purrr::imap_dfr(mz_named_k6, function(x, nm) {
  parts  <- strsplit(nm, "_")[[1]]
  samp   <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
  lag_yn <- length(parts) >= 3 && parts[3] == "lags"
  # internal label is nm + _k6
  int_label <- paste0(nm, "_k6")
  tibble(configuration     = nm,
         config_join       = int_label,
         clustering        = "UMAP+HDBSCAN",
         sampling_design   = ifelse(samp == "SP",
                                    "Single-point", "Composite"),
         pred_method       = method,
         spatial_lags      = lag_yn,
         n_zones           = x$n_zones,
         pct_noise_prefill = round(x$pct_noise, 1))
}) %>%
  left_join(
    all_kw_k6 %>%
      filter(approach == "UMAP+HDBSCAN") %>%
      group_by(dataset) %>%
      summarise(n_sig_vars = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups    = "drop") %>%
      rename(config_join = dataset),
    by = "config_join"
  ) %>%
  mutate(n_sig_vars = replace_na(n_sig_vars, 0L)) %>%
  left_join(
    zone_validation_all_k6 %>%
      filter(approach == "UMAP+HDBSCAN") %>%
      select(configuration, VR, silhouette),
    by = "configuration"
  )

summary_pca_k6 <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  baseline_list_k6, function(b, nm) {
    clean   <- str_remove(nm, "_kmeans")
    has_lag <- str_detect(clean, "_lags")
    clean   <- str_remove(clean, "_lags")
    parts   <- strsplit(clean, "_")[[1]]
    samp    <- parts[1]; method <- parts[2]
    # internal label matches val_kmeans_k6 internal labels
    int_label <- if_else(
      has_lag,
      paste0(samp, "_", method, "_lags_kmeans_k6"),
      paste0(samp, "_", method, "_kmeans_k6")
    )
    tibble(configuration     = nm,
           config_join       = int_label,
           clustering        = "PCA+kmeans",
           sampling_design   = ifelse(samp == "SP",
                                      "Single-point", "Composite"),
           pred_method       = method,
           spatial_lags      = has_lag,
           n_zones           = b$best_k,
           pct_noise_prefill = 0)
  }) %>%
  left_join(
    all_kw_k6 %>%
      filter(approach == "PCA+kmeans") %>%
      group_by(dataset) %>%
      summarise(n_sig_vars = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups    = "drop") %>%
      rename(config_join = dataset),
    by = "config_join"
  ) %>%
  mutate(n_sig_vars = replace_na(n_sig_vars, 0L)) %>%
  left_join(
    zone_validation_all_k6 %>%
      filter(approach == "PCA+kmeans") %>%
      select(configuration, VR, silhouette),
    by = "configuration"
  )

final_summary_k6 <- bind_rows(summary_umap_k6,
                                summary_pca_k6) %>%
  left_join(zone_pred_rmse_k6, by = "config_join") %>%
  left_join(obs_vr_all_k6,     by = "config_join") %>%
  left_join(zone_r2_k6 %>%
              select(config_join, r2_obs_pred),
            by = "config_join") %>%
  select(-config_join)

# Verify joins worked
cat("\nfinal_summary_k6 — missing VR_obs count:",
    sum(is.na(final_summary_k6$observed_VR_med)), "\n")
cat("final_summary_k6 — missing RMSE count:",
    sum(is.na(final_summary_k6$median_zone_rmse)), "\n")

print(final_summary_k6 %>%
        select(configuration, clustering, n_zones,
               VR, n_sig_vars, median_zone_rmse,
               observed_VR_med, n_pos_VR, r2_obs_pred) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))),
      n = 20)
# ── 12. Print ranking ─────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Fixed k=6 sensitivity — composite scores ===\n")
final_summary_k6 %>%
  left_join(final_ranked_k6, by = "configuration") %>%
  arrange(desc(Score)) %>%
  select(configuration, clustering, n_zones,
         VR, silhouette, n_sig_vars,
         median_zone_rmse, observed_VR_med,
         n_pos_VR, r2_obs_pred, Score) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = 20)

# ── 13. gt table ──────────────────────────────────────────
table_data_k6 <- final_summary_k6 %>%
  left_join(final_ranked_k6, by = "configuration") %>%
  mutate(
    Approach  = clustering,
    Sampling  = ifelse(sampling_design == "Single-point",
                       "SP", "COMP"),
    Method    = pred_method,
    Lags      = ifelse(spatial_lags, "Yes", "No"),
    Zones     = n_zones,
    VR_pred   = round(VR,               3),
    Sil       = round(silhouette,       3),
    N_sig_pct = round(100 * n_sig_vars /
                        length(soil_vars), 1),
    RMSE_zone = round(median_zone_rmse, 1),
    VR_obs    = round(observed_VR_med,  3),
    N_pos     = n_pos_VR,
    R2        = round(r2_obs_pred,      3)
  ) %>%
  select(Approach, Sampling, Method, Lags, Zones,
         VR_pred, Sil, N_sig_pct, RMSE_zone,
         VR_obs, N_pos, R2, Score) %>%
  arrange(Approach, Sampling, Method, Lags)

best_k6 <- list(
  VR_pred   = max(table_data_k6$VR_pred,   na.rm = TRUE),
  Sil       = max(table_data_k6$Sil,       na.rm = TRUE),
  N_sig_pct = max(table_data_k6$N_sig_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
  RMSE_zone = min(table_data_k6$RMSE_zone, na.rm = TRUE),
  VR_obs    = max(table_data_k6$VR_obs,    na.rm = TRUE),
  N_pos     = max(table_data_k6$N_pos,     na.rm = TRUE),
  R2        = max(table_data_k6$R2,        na.rm = TRUE),
  Score     = max(table_data_k6$Score,     na.rm = TRUE)
)

tbl_k6 <- table_data_k6 %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Approach") %>%
  cols_label(
    Sampling  = "Sampling",
    Method    = "Pred. method",
    Lags      = "Lags",
    Zones     = md("*k*"),
    VR_pred   = md("VR~pred~"),
    Sil       = "Silhouette",
    N_sig_pct = md("*N*~sig~ (%)"),
    RMSE_zone = md("RMSE~zone~"),
    VR_obs    = md("VR~obs~ (median)"),
    N_pos     = md("*N*~pos~"),
    R2        = md("*R*²"),
    Score     = "Score"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = md("**Configuration**"),
    columns = c(Sampling, Method, Lags, Zones)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = md("**Zone structure** *(all grid pixels)*"),
    columns = c(VR_pred, Sil)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = md("**Agronomic validation** *(held-out, n = 59)*"),
    columns = c(N_sig_pct, RMSE_zone, VR_obs, N_pos, R2)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = md("**Overall**"),
    columns = Score
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_fill(color = "#fde8e8"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = VR_obs,
      rows    = !is.na(VR_obs) & VR_obs < 0)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(color = "#c0392b"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = VR_obs,
      rows    = !is.na(VR_obs) & VR_obs < 0)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = Score,
      rows    = !is.na(Score) & Score == best_k6$Score)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = VR_pred,
      rows    = !is.na(VR_pred) & VR_pred == best_k6$VR_pred)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = Sil,
      rows    = !is.na(Sil) & Sil == best_k6$Sil)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = N_sig_pct,
      rows    = !is.na(N_sig_pct) &
                  N_sig_pct == best_k6$N_sig_pct)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = RMSE_zone,
      rows    = !is.na(RMSE_zone) &
                  RMSE_zone == best_k6$RMSE_zone)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = VR_obs,
      rows    = !is.na(VR_obs) &
                  VR_obs == best_k6$VR_obs)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = N_pos,
      rows    = !is.na(N_pos) & N_pos == best_k6$N_pos)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "#1a5276"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = R2,
      rows    = !is.na(R2) & R2 == best_k6$R2)
  ) %>%
  fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(VR_pred, Sil, VR_obs, R2, Score),
             decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(N_sig_pct, RMSE_zone),
             decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_integer(columns = c(Zones, N_pos)) %>%
  tab_caption(md(paste0(
    "**Table S1.** Sensitivity analysis: zone quality metrics ",
    "with all configurations fixed at k = 6 zones. ",
    "UMAP+HDBSCAN configurations were retuned to the minPts ",
    "value producing the closest zone count to k = 6; ",
    "actual zone counts shown in *k* column. ",
    "PCA+k-means configurations were refitted at k = 6 using ",
    "existing PCA scores. All other methods and metrics ",
    "identical to Table 1. ",
    "Score = normalized composite index (0–1, higher = better). ",
    "Red = negative VR~obs~."
  ))) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size                   = px(11),
    column_labels.font.size           = px(11),
    table.width                       = pct(100),
    data_row.padding                  = px(4),
    table.border.top.style            = "solid",
    table.border.top.width            = px(2),
    table.border.top.color            = "#2c3e50",
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#7f8c8d"
  )

tbl_k6
gt::gtsave(tbl_k6, "../outputs/tableS1_fixed_k6.html")
cat("Sensitivity table saved.\n")

save.image("../outputs/workspace_k6_sensitivity.RData")
beep("complete")

# ── Score vs k scatter — Table 1 vs Table S1 ──────────────
bind_rows(
  # Table 1 results
  final_summary %>%
    left_join(final_ranked, by = "configuration") %>%
    mutate(analysis = "Data-adaptive k (Table 1)",
           k = n_zones),
  
  # Table S1 results

    left_join(final_ranked_k6, by = "configuration") %>%

) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = k, y = Score,
